notes: Ranked vegetarian (egg and dairy OK) alternatives for every meat/fish role in the book and web recipes. meatPer100g is RAW weight (book amounts are raw) except chicken_cooked and deli_chicken. Alternative per100g is as sold (dry weight for TVP and soy chunks). availability is for typical US supermarkets in 2026: everywhere = Walmart/Target/Kroger-level ubiquity, most_stores = most large chains, specialty = Indian/Asian groceries, online or homemade. aliasKeys list the keys existing vegAdaptation swaps use for the same product. Stocks, oyster/fish sauce, Worcestershire, gelatin and Parmesan are handled by vegAdaptation swaps, not here.

alternatives.name: Seitan (wheat gluten)
alternatives.whereToBuy: Whole Foods, Sprouts, Kroger family, Safeway/Albertsons, H-E-B (refrigerated tofu case); or make it from Bob's Red Mill vital wheat gluten (Walmart, Target, Kroger)
alternatives.brands: Upton's Naturals Traditional Seitan, Sweet Earth Traditional Seitan; homemade from vital wheat gluten
alternatives.prep: Tear or slice into strips, simmer 5 min in seasoned stock, pat dry, then use the recipe's coating and air-fry 200 °C / 400 °F for 8-10 min
alternatives.why: Closest chew and the most protein per calorie; crisps and shreds like chicken breast
alternatives.nutritionSource: Upton's Naturals Traditional Seitan label: 57 g = 90 kcal, 18 g P, 5 g C, 0.5 g F

alternatives.name: Extra-firm tofu
